candidates.title: Move Sign-In After Adoption Selection
candidates.change: Move the sign-in step to occur after users have picked and customized their pet, letting them build emotional investment before creating an account.
candidates.why: Sign-in conversion drops 27.1% early on before users have chosen a pet, and sign-in takes a long mean time (567s). Deferring sign-in builds ownership first.

guard.reason: Moving sign-in after pet adoption is explicitly permitted under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Deferring sign-in builds ownership to address the 27.1% sign-in drop.

candidates.title: Desktop Controls Interactive Tutorial Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated visual guide screen right after home intro teaching users how to interact, drag, hide, and right-click their new desktop pet.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple complaints about users being confused on how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after onboarding completes.

new_controls_guide.headline: How to Play with Your Desktop Pet
new_controls_guide.body: Click to pet, drag to relocate, and right-click for controls and quick menu options.

components.text: Try dragging your pet after finishing!

guard.reason: Adding a new interactive guide screen after home_intro is permitted under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Addresses support complaints about controls and late drop-off at finish step.

candidates.title: Redesign Adoption Certificate Screen
candidates.change: Transform the adoption certificate into an interactive stage layout with live pet mascot preview, animated stamp, and prominent name input.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the highest drop-off rate in the flow with only 60.9% conversion and a median time of 89s.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Give your new companion a name to finalize your official adoption!

guard.reason: The redesigned certificate lacks an official stamp component, failing to fulfill the required screen job.

candidates.title: Pet Quiz Discovery Pre-Flow
candidates.change: Add a quick 2-question pet style match quiz screen before path selection to help users choose between pre-made pets and custom generation.
candidates.why: Choose path has a massive mean completion time of 514s (median 8s), showing hesitation and decision paralysis.

new_pet_quiz.headline: Find Your Ideal Desktop Match
new_pet_quiz.body: Answer a quick question to help us suggest the best companion for your workflow.

guard.reason: Adding a new quiz screen before path selection is allowed under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Reduces decision paralysis on choose_path (514s mean time) with pre-flow quiz.

candidates.title: Redesign Waiting Screen with Interactive Tips
candidates.change: Redesign the waiting screen to split view featuring progress indicators, estimated time remaining, and a tip carousel explaining desktop shortcuts.
candidates.why: The waiting screen (home step) takes a median 201s / mean 2336s, leading to drop-offs (81.3% conversion) and support questions about desktop features.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Home
waiting.body: We are generating assets and configuring your pet's desktop engine.

components.text: Tip: Press your shortcut key anytime to summon or hide your desktop pet.

guard.reason: The redesigned waiting screen continues to show that the pet is being generated.

candidates.score_note: Keeps users engaged during long home waiting time (201s median / 2336s mean).

candidates.title: Account Persistence Warning on Sign In
candidates.change: Clarify sign-in copy to emphasize that pet progress and adoption certificates are permanently saved to the selected account.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again with a secondary account.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Companion to Your Account
sign_in.body: Sign in to permanently link your pet and preserve its memory across re-installs or new devices.
sign_in.hint: Make sure to use your main account so your pet is always saved.

guard.reason: Updating sign-in copy to clarify account persistence is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Cheap copy change addressing 8 support emails about account persistence.

candidates.title: Photo Quality Guidelines on Custom Pet Upload
candidates.change: Add photo selection guidelines and a live sample preview to photo upload screen to prevent custom generation failures.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported that custom pet creation fails or looks wrong due to poor photo inputs.

upload_photos.hint: Use clear, well-lit photos with a single subject facing forward for best custom pet results.

guard.reason: Adding photo quality hints and preview components to photo upload is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Fixes custom pet upload failures reported in 3 support emails.

candidates.title: Welcome Gift & Starter Item Incentive
candidates.change: Add a welcome gift unlock banner on the home intro screen giving users a free pet accessory upon completing setup.
candidates.why: Finish step conversion drops to 64.8% (median 395s), leaving total onboarding completion at just 17.8%.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion Has Arrived!
home_intro.body: Complete setup now to receive a free Starter Toy bundle for your desktop pet!

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions a free starter toy gift, violating rule 3 against mentioning gifts or free extras.

candidates.title: Background Preparation Notification Toggle
candidates.change: Enable desktop notification toggle and clear time estimate display while pet assets finish generating in background.
candidates.why: Waiting step takes up to 2336s mean time, causing users to close app prematurely (3 emails report app won't open or show pet).

waiting.hint: You can minimize this window. We'll notify you as soon as your pet appears on your desktop!

guard.reason: Adding time estimates and background notifications to the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Prevents premature exit during background generation backed by support emails.

candidates.title: Grid Selection Layout for Pick Friend Screen
candidates.change: Change the layout of pick_friend screen to a visual grid featuring larger choice cards and pet personality sound snippets.
candidates.why: Adoption step has a high median time (89s) and low conversion (60.9%), indicating layout friction during selection.

guard.reason: Redesigning pick_friend to a grid layout preserves its core function of letting the user choose a pet.

candidates.score_note: Targets adoption step (worst funnel step conversion at 60.9%) by reducing layout friction.

Photo Quality Guidelines on Custom Pet Upload

lessons_next: Reordering the onboarding flow (moving sign-in after selection) was helpful (+13.0%).
Redesigning screens with interactive elements (waiting screen redesign) hurt performance (-7.6%).
Adding guidelines/hints (photo quality guidelines) had no clear effect.
Predictions for flow reordering were accurate (+12.0% predicted vs +13.0% measured).
Predictions were far too high for visual redesigns (+8.0% predicted vs -7.6% measured) and hints (+4.0% predicted vs no clear effect).
